# Speakerfolio

> Speakerfolio is a speaker directory where every speaker has a real website. Event planners search and send booking requests for free, with no booking fee. Speakerfolio also builds free one-page websites for public speakers, trainers and coaches. Sites go live on yourname.speakerfolio.com in about two working days, after the speaker approves a private preview. Premium moves the site to the speaker's own domain with hosting included.

## Pages
- [Home](https://speakerfolio.com/): speaker directory home: find keynote speakers, trainers and coaches by topic and format
- [Find a speaker](https://speakerfolio.com/speakers/): every listed speaker, with filters by topic, format and location. Topic pages: https://speakerfolio.com/speakers/topic/leadership/, https://speakerfolio.com/speakers/topic/sales/, https://speakerfolio.com/speakers/topic/motivation/, https://speakerfolio.com/speakers/topic/hr-and-culture/, https://speakerfolio.com/speakers/topic/technology/, https://speakerfolio.com/speakers/topic/health-and-wellbeing/, https://speakerfolio.com/speakers/topic/communication/, https://speakerfolio.com/speakers/topic/entrepreneurship/
- [For speakers](https://speakerfolio.com/for-speakers/): free speaker websites, how it works, templates and the request form
- [Templates](https://speakerfolio.com/templates/): six free speaker website templates (Headliner, Ignite, Coach, Trainer, Studio, Spotlight)
- [Pricing](https://speakerfolio.com/pricing/): Free plan; Premium $500 a year (launch offer $100) on your own domain with hosting included; social media design $40 a month
- [Articles](https://speakerfolio.com/articles/): short guides for speakers
- [FAQ](https://speakerfolio.com/faq/)
- [Contact](https://speakerfolio.com/contact/): request a free website or ask a question
- [About](https://speakerfolio.com/about/): who runs Speakerfolio and how we work
- [Speakerfolio vs Wix](https://speakerfolio.com/compare/speakerfolio-vs-wix/): speaker websites compared
- [Speakerfolio vs Squarespace](https://speakerfolio.com/compare/speakerfolio-vs-squarespace/): speaker websites compared
- [Terms and privacy](https://speakerfolio.com/terms.html)

## FAQ
- **Is the free website really free?** Yes. No card and no trial period. Your one-page site at yourname.speakerfolio.com stays free for as long as you use it. The only condition is a small designer credit in the footer.
- **What do I need to send?** Your name, email and LinkedIn profile. A YouTube talk helps but is optional. We write your bio and talks from your profile and use your LinkedIn photo unless you send a better one.
- **How long until my site is live?** We email you a private preview within two working days. Once you approve it, your site goes live the same day.
- **What is the difference between Free and Premium?** Free is a one-page site from one of our six templates on a speakerfolio.com address. Premium is a custom design on your own domain with as many pages as you need, full admin access, no credit, and your first month of social media posts designed for you.
- **Do I need my own domain for Premium?** Yes, and it is registered in your name so it always stays yours. Domains usually cost $10 to $20 a year from a registrar. If you do not have one yet, we help you choose and set it up.
- **Is hosting included with Premium?** Yes. Your Premium site runs on our servers at no extra cost, with an SSL certificate, daily backups and updates handled for you. Hosting like this usually costs $100 to $300 a year with other providers. You only pay for the domain itself.
- **How does social media design work?** Each month we design 20 posts in your website's colours and fonts: talk announcements, audience quotes, event posts and tip carousels, with captions. It is $40 a month on either plan, the first month is included with Premium, and you can stop any month.
- **Who owns my content?** You do. Your bio, photos, videos and testimonials stay yours, and you can ask for a copy at any time.
- **Can I start free and upgrade later?** Yes, at any time. When you move to Premium, your speakerfolio.com address redirects to your new domain, so every link you have shared keeps working.
